_doc: Category-32 (Condiments, Sauces and Dressings) compiler config for tools/standards/compile-cat32.mjs — HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default). Numbers come ONLY from data/evidence/regulatory_limits.csv, selected per subcategory by explicit scope regex, strictest across jurisdictions, at FACE VALUE. Vinegar and tomato condiments have direct sovereign scopes (Vietnam QCVN 8-2 vinegar; Paraguay/MERCOSUR tomato concentrates; Singapore Food Regs ketchup). Soy sauce, fish sauce and mustard/mayo/dressings have NO direct sovereign ML and resolve by disclosed read-across from the nearest sovereign analog: Singapore 'tomato ketchup and other sauces' for the terrestrial condiment sauces; fish-muscle MLs for fish sauce (a fermented marine product); EU fruiting-vegetable nickel for tomato condiments. FISH SAUCE is the marine case: methylmercury IS material (aquatic methylation pathway) and is read across from the fish MeHg ML (Mexico NOM-242 500), then reconciled against the total-mercury read-across (EU lower-mercury fish 300) — where MeHg is not below tHg it is subsumed. No occurrence percentiles anywhere; every unregulated cell is a disclosed read-across, a control (reflex screen where a pathway exists), or a rebuttable not-material determination tested against the register each build.

vinegar.name: Vinegar (distilled, wine, balsamic, cider, rice)
vinegar.lineage_note: Vietnam QCVN 8-2 sets vinegar-specific MLs (Pb 500, tHg 50) and governs those cells directly. Cadmium and total arsenic are governed instead by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for LIQUID foods (Cd 100, tAs 100; uy_rbn_general_cd_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg / uy_rbn_general_tas_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg) — a national catch-all that binds every liquid food without a particular limit and is tighter than the Vietnam vinegar values (Cd 1000, tAs 200). Hidden-hazard flag for the ratchet, NOT a missing limit: the FDA has issued balsamic- and wine-vinegar lead warning letters (grape-derived lead concentrated during must reduction, compounded historically by lead-bearing equipment), and measured balsamic lead can approach or exceed 500 ug/kg — so ALARA and the occurrence ratchet drive tightening after publication even though the sovereign ceiling is the correct initial value. Nickel and total chromium are held under a stainless-steel-migration screen because an acidic food in prolonged stainless contact leaches both.

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for vinegar; total arsenic is governed (200, Vietnam). Inorganic arsenic is the toxic species, obtained by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: Vinegar is a fermented fruit- or grain-derived acid with no aquatic methylation pathway and no fish source. Total mercury is governed (50, Vietnam).

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for vinegar, but an acidic food in prolonged contact with stainless steel (fermentation and storage vessels, tubing) leaches nickel. Because a real migration pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen rather than declared not-material.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for vinegar, but an acidic food in prolonged stainless-steel contact leaches chromium alongside nickel. Held under a reflex screen; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; vinegar is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. A canned/tinned acidic product would fall under the canned-food tin ML and is out of this subcategory's scope.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for vinegar and no aluminium pathway operates in a bottled acid. Rebuttable and audited each build.

soy-sauce-fermented.name: Soy sauce and fermented seasoning sauces
soy-sauce-fermented.lineage_note: Soy sauce is a fermented seasoning SAUCE. Lead is governed by China GB 2762 'Condiments excluding spices' (Pb 1000; china_gb2762_pb_condiments_excl_spices_1000), whose Appendix A.1 explicitly places soy sauce and compound/blended condiments under this line — stricter than the Vietnam QCVN 8-2 generic 'Sauce' Pb 2000. Cadmium and total arsenic are governed by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for LIQUID foods (Cd 100, tAs 100; uy_rbn_general_cd_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg / uy_rbn_general_tas_liquid_foods_0_1mgkg), a pourable soy sauce being a liquid food; these bind below the Vietnam 'Sauce' Cd 1000 / tAs 1000 and the Singapore 'tomato ketchup and other sauces' tAs 1000. Total mercury is the Vietnam 'Sauce' value (tHg 50). Soy sauce has a documented lead-contamination history (e.g. Hong Kong recalls), so the ratchet still applies. Nickel is held under a soy-accumulation screen because soybeans concentrate nickel (EU regulates soybean nickel at 15000) and no sovereign sets a sauce nickel ML. Total chromium is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong Cap 132V pulses total-chromium ML (1000), soy sauce being a pulse/legume ferment.
soy-sauce-fermented.audit_scope: soy sauce|soya sauce|\bsauces?\b|liquid foods in general

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for soy sauce; total arsenic is governed at 1000 (Vietnam 'Sauce'). Inorganic arsenic is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no fish source in a soy/wheat ferment.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for soy sauce, but soybeans are strong nickel accumulators (EU regulates soybean nickel at 15000) and the ferment is soy-derived, so a real source pathway exists. Held under a reflex screen.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: A sovereign total-chromium context does exist for the source commodity: Hong Kong Cap 132V sets total chromium at 1000 ug/kg for pulses (hk_cap132v_crtotal_pulses_1000), and soy sauce is a soybean (pulse/legume) ferment, so the pulse total-chromium ML is the nearest sovereign analog. An acidic, fermented product in prolonged stainless-steel contact also leaches chromium alongside nickel. Because a real source and migration pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong pulses total-chromium ML (1000) — matching the sibling vinegar chromium control — rather than declared not-material; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; soy sauce is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for soy sauce and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

fish-sauce.name: Fish sauce (fermented anchovy/marine sauce)
fish-sauce.lineage_note: No sovereign sets a fish-sauce ML. Fish sauce is a fermented marine product (anchovy hydrolysate), so every metal reads across from the fish-muscle sovereign MLs of the marine source: Pb 300 (EU muscle meat of fish), Cd 50 (Costa Rica fish in general), tAs 2000 (AU-NZ fish), iAs 100 (EU 2025/1891 muscle meat of fish), tHg 300 (EU lower-mercury fish). The generic Vietnam 'Sauce' MLs (tHg 50 etc.) are deliberately NOT applied: fish sauce is a marine fermentate whose contaminant profile follows its fish source, not the condiment-sauce category — and Vietnam, the world's largest fish-sauce producer, does not cap nuoc mam mercury at the generic-sauce 50 (anchovy-based fish sauce routinely exceeds it), which confirms nuoc mam sits outside that category. The generic-sauce values are retained in the audit trail as a different product form. Methylmercury IS material here — the aquatic methylation pathway is the whole point of a marine read-across — and is read across from the fish MeHg ML (Mexico NOM-242 500); it is then reconciled against total mercury, and because 500 is not below the 300 total-mercury ceiling it is subsumed (bounded by tHg, enforced by reflex speciation). Inorganic arsenic (100) is published alongside total arsenic (2000) because it is a strictly tighter toxic-species control: arsenic in fish is high but predominantly organic (arsenobetaine).

Pb.label: read-across from EU 2023/915 muscle meat of fish Pb 300 — fish sauce is a marine (fish-derived) product; the fish-muscle lead ML is the source-appropriate sovereign value.

Cd.label: read-across from Costa Rica RTCR 409 'fish in general' Cd 50 — the strictest sovereign fish-muscle cadmium ML.

tAs.label: read-across from AU-NZ Standard 1.4.1 fish tAs 2000 — total arsenic in fish is high but predominantly organic; the tighter inorganic control is the operative arsenic ceiling.

iAs.label: read-across from EU 2025/1891 muscle meat of fish inorganic-arsenic 100 — the toxic-species control; strictly below the total-arsenic read-across, so both are published.

tHg.label: read-across from EU 2023/915 lower-mercury fish tHg 300 — fish sauce is made from small forage fish (anchovy), which fall in the lower-mercury tier.

MeHg.label: read-across from Mexico NOM-242 other-fishery methylmercury 500 — methylmercury IS material for a marine product (aquatic methylation pathway). Reconciled against total mercury: 500 is not below the 300 total-mercury ceiling, so methylmercury is subsumed and bounded by tHg.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for fish sauce and fish are not nickel accumulators (the EU nickel regulation sets no fish ML). No concentration pathway comparable to a soybean or a hydrogenated fat operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

Cr.rationale: A sovereign total-chromium context does exist for the source commodity: Hong Kong Cap 132V sets total chromium at 1000 ug/kg for fish (hk_cap132v_crtotal_fish_1000), and fish sauce is a fermented marine (fish-derived) product, so the fish total-chromium ML is the nearest sovereign analog. Because a real source pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong fish total-chromium ML (1000) rather than declared not-material; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; fish sauce is sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for fish sauce and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.

tomato-condiments.name: Tomato condiments (ketchup, salsa)
tomato-condiments.lineage_note: Ketchup and salsa are certified against the stricter tomato-CONCENTRATE lead and total-arsenic MLs (Pb/tAs 500, Paraguay/MERCOSUR) rather than the looser finished-ketchup (Singapore 2000) or generic-sauce (Vietnam 'Sauce' Pb 2000 / tAs 1000) MLs — a protective, government-cited choice; the finished-ketchup, generic-sauce, and canned/preserved whole-tomato MLs (Pb 50) are retained in the per-country audit trail as different product forms. Cadmium is governed by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for SOLID foods (Cd 200; uy_rbn_general_cd_solid_foods_0_2mgkg), a semisolid tomato condiment being a solid food; this binds below the Vietnam 'Sauce' Cd 1000, and no tomato-specific cadmium value exists (tomatoes are explicitly carved OUT of the fruiting-vegetable cadmium ML). Total mercury (50) is governed by the Vietnam generic 'Sauce' category. Nickel reads across from the EU fruiting-vegetable Ni ML (400) because tomatoes are fruiting vegetables. Total chromium is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong Cap 132V vegetables-other-than-pulses total-chromium ML (500), tomato being a fruiting vegetable. Canned tomato condiments fall under the canned-food tin ML and are out of this bottled subcategory's scope.

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for tomato condiments; total arsenic is governed (500, tomato concentrates). Inorganic arsenic is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no fish source in a tomato condiment.

Ni.label: read-across from EU 2024/1987 fruiting-vegetables nickel 400 — tomatoes are fruiting vegetables; the source-commodity nickel ML applied at face value.

Cr.rationale: A sovereign total-chromium context does exist for the source commodity: Hong Kong Cap 132V sets total chromium at 500 ug/kg for vegetables other than pulses (hk_cap132v_crtotal_vegetables-other-than-pulses_500), and tomato condiments are a fruiting-vegetable product, so the vegetable total-chromium ML is the nearest sovereign analog. Because a real source pathway exists, the cell is held under a reflex screen disclosed against the Hong Kong vegetables total-chromium ML (500) rather than declared not-material; any total-chromium exceedance triggers Cr(VI) speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation (EPA 3060A + EPA 6800 / EN 15192) on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; this subcategory is bottled ketchup and salsa in glass or plastic. Canned tomato condiments carry the canned-food tin ML and are out of scope here.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for tomato condiments and no aluminium pathway operates in a bottled product. Rebuttable and audited each build.

mustard-mayo-dressings.name: Prepared mustard, mayonnaise and salad dressings
mustard-mayo-dressings.lineage_note: Prepared mustard, mayonnaise and salad dressings are condiment SAUCES. Lead is governed by China GB 2762 'Condiments excluding spices' (Pb 1000; china_gb2762_pb_condiments_excl_spices_1000), which covers compound/blended condiments — stricter than the Vietnam QCVN 8-2 generic 'Sauce' Pb 2000. Cadmium is governed by the stricter Uruguay RBN general limit for SOLID foods (Cd 200; uy_rbn_general_cd_solid_foods_0_2mgkg), these semisolid emulsions being solid foods, binding below the Vietnam 'Sauce' Cd 1000. Total arsenic is the Singapore 'tomato ketchup and other sauces' finished-sauce value (tAs 1000, tied with the Uruguay solid-food general limit); total mercury is the Vietnam 'Sauce' value (tHg 50). Nickel is held under a seed/oil-derived screen (mustard is a brassica seed; mayonnaise and vinaigrettes are oil emulsions carrying nickel from the oil fraction). The register's mustard OIL (India vegetable-oils) and mustard GREENS (EU leafy) MLs are different product forms and are excluded from selection and downgraded in the audit.

iAs.rationale: No sovereign inorganic-arsenic ML exists for these condiments; total arsenic is governed at 1000 (Vietnam 'Sauce'). Inorganic arsenic is controlled by reflex speciation on any elevated total arsenic.
iAs.reference_method: Total As by ICP-MS; reflex iAs speciation (HPLC-ICP-MS) on any total-As exceedance.

MeHg.rationale: No methylation pathway and no fish source in a seed/oil/egg condiment.

Ni.rationale: No sovereign nickel ML exists for these condiments, but mustard is a brassica seed and mayonnaise and vinaigrettes are oil emulsions that carry any nickel from the oil fraction (residual hydrogenation catalyst in a hardened component). Held under a reflex screen.
Ni.reference_method: Total nickel by ICP-MS on each lot; monitored under ALARA against the tightest available food nickel context.

Cr.rationale: No sovereign total-chromium ML exists for these condiments; the only food chromium MLs in the register are dairy. Rebuttable and audited each build.
Cr.reference_method: Total Cr by ICP-MS screen; reflex Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium is never a panel number for a food; it is the reflex-speciation species. Any total-chromium exceedance is speciated, and any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails.
Cr-VI.reference_method: IC-ICP-MS Cr(VI) speciation on any total-Cr exceedance.

Sn.rationale: Tin migrates only from tinplate cans; these condiments are sold in glass or plastic, not tinplate. No non-canned tin pathway exists.

Al.rationale: No sovereign aluminium ML exists for these condiments and no aluminium pathway operates. Rebuttable and audited each build.
